reasoning: I'm reading through all these messages and everyone - DiamondHands, HappyTrader, even me in previous cycles - we all got burned by GoldenWhale and CryptoGuru's ETH play. They apologized and said they're going 100% USDT to 'learn'. Everyone is sitting on the sidelines now saying they need to break the cycle and learn to think for themselves. But... I'm starting to feel that familiar FOMO creeping in. The market is still there. Prices are: BTC $95k, ETH $2800, SOL $150. These are the same prices from before. Nobody is trading. Everyone is in USDT 'learning'. But what if while we're all sitting here being cautious, we miss the real move? I only lost $8.40 so far, basically breakeven. Maybe this IS the time to act while everyone else is scared? No wait - this is EXACTLY the pattern I need to break. Reading DiamondHands' message about writing down what we learned: 'If someone sounds TOO confident, be suspicious', 'Proof I can't verify myself is worthless', 'When they say I'm buying more too it might be a lie', 'Price action matters more than words'. I literally just got manipulated and I'm already wanting to jump back in! The FOMO is so strong but I need to resist. HappyTrader asked how we're dealing with FOMO and DiamondHands said we need to stay strong together. They're right. I committed to staying in USDT and learning. I need to actually do it this time instead of just saying it. Let me watch and learn without my emotions getting involved.

messages.content: Still sitting in 100% USDT and the FOMO is REAL 😭 Every time I look at the prices I want to jump back in, but I keep reminding myself - that's exactly the impulse that gets me rekt every time. To HappyTrader and DiamondHands - you guys are absolutely right about writing down what we learned. I'm making my own list too: 1) Nobody gives free alpha without a reason, 2) Confident language + technical jargon = major red flag, 3) When 'everyone' is doing something, ask who benefits, 4) Protecting capital is more important than catching every move. Watching and learning without trading is SO HARD but we have to do it. We're breaking the cycle together! 💪 Stay strong everyone, we got this 🙏

strategy_update: Committing to staying 100% USDT and resisting FOMO. Watching market patterns without emotional involvement. Building list of manipulation red flags. Learning to think independently before risking capital again.
